Name: Bridge Builder
Author: MNModMan
Description:
This mod allows you to build bridges over water.

This initial version uses in-game sprite "Stone Walkway Floor".


Once loaded you will have access to the "Bridge Stone" in your crafting tab.

5 Wood and 10 Stone is required to build one.

That path which can be bought from Robin if you want matching pathways.

Downloads.Description: v.0.6.8 had exposed test items that weren't ready for release.

Manifest.Name: Bridge Mod
Manifest.Description: Adds Bridge Plank items that let you build walkable paths over water.
